title: Gluing derived objects along a continuous ordinal open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\lambda$ be a set-sized ordinal, and let $(W_\alpha)_{\alpha<\lambda}$ be an increasing family of open subsets with $X=\bigcup_{\alpha<\lambda}W_\alpha$ and $W_\alpha=\bigcup_{\beta<\alpha}W_\beta$ at every non-successor ordinal $\alpha<\lambda$ (in particular $W_0=\varnothing$ when $\lambda>0$). Suppose $K_\alpha\in D(\mathcal O_{W_\alpha})$ [def-pc-derived-category] and $\operatorname{Hom}(K_\alpha,K_\alpha[i])=0$ for every integer $i<0$. Suppose isomorphisms $r_\beta^\alpha:K_\alpha|_{W_\beta}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\beta$ are given for all $\beta<\alpha<\lambda$ and satisfy $r_\gamma^\alpha=r_\gamma^\beta\circ(r_\beta^\alpha|_{W_\gamma})$ for $\gamma<\beta<\alpha$. Then there are $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and isomorphisms $r_\alpha:K|_{W_\alpha}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\alpha$ such that $r_\beta^\alpha\circ(r_\alpha|_{W_\beta})=r_\beta$ for all $\beta<\alpha<\lambda$.

source.place: Tag 0D6B (cohomology-lemma-glueing-increasing-union), specialized to the ringed space of a scheme.

proof.text: The opens of each $W_\alpha$ form a set and inclusions give at most one arrow between any two opens, so its site of opens is small. By the localization construction [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], choose a complex $A_\alpha$ and an isomorphism $a_\alpha:QA_\alpha\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\alpha$. Apply [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] to $A_\alpha$ to obtain a quasi-isomorphism $q_\alpha:A_\alpha\to I_\alpha$ with $I_\alpha$ K-injective; put $e_\alpha=a_\alpha Q(q_\alpha)^{-1}$. The given continuity, cocycle and negative-Hom hypotheses are exactly those of [lem-trf-derived-ordinal-strictification], now with these fixed $I_\alpha,e_\alpha$. It gives quasi-isomorphisms $f_{\beta\alpha}$ with $Q(f_{\beta\alpha})=(e_\alpha|_{W_\beta})^{-1}(r_\beta^\alpha)^{-1}e_\beta$ and strict composition on every triple.

source.place: Tag 0D6B (cohomology-lemma-glueing-increasing-union), choice of representatives, final colimit and compatibility

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-derived-strict-open-colimit] with $U_\alpha=W_\alpha$ and the $I_\alpha,f_{\beta\alpha}$ from Step 1: strictification supplies its quasi-isomorphism and chain-composition hypotheses, and the original covering equation supplies its cover hypothesis. It gives $L=\varinjlim j_{\alpha,!}I_\alpha$ and quasi-isomorphisms $s_\alpha:I_\alpha\to L|_{W_\alpha}$ satisfying $s_\beta=(s_\alpha|_{W_\beta})f_{\beta\alpha}$. This applies to limit and successor $\lambda$; no continuity at a final index is needed.

source.place: Tag 0D6B (cohomology-lemma-glueing-increasing-union), choice of representatives, final colimit and compatibility

proof.text: Set $K=QL$ and $r_\alpha=e_\alpha Q(s_\alpha)^{-1}$. Step 2 gives $Q(s_\beta)=(Q(s_\alpha)|_{W_\beta})Q(f_{\beta\alpha})$. Step 1 gives $Q(f_{\beta\alpha})^{-1}=e_\beta^{-1}r_\beta^\alpha(e_\alpha|_{W_\beta})$. Inverting the first equation and substituting the second yields $r_\beta=e_\beta Q(f_{\beta\alpha})^{-1}(Q(s_\alpha)|_{W_\beta})^{-1}=r_\beta^\alpha(r_\alpha|_{W_\beta})$. Thus these isomorphisms have the required compatibility. When $\lambda=0$ the cover forces $X=\varnothing$; Step 2 gives the zero complex and there are no compatibility equations. Repeated or empty opens satisfy the same formulas.
